description: This file defines a Perl module 'Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix' which implements a template filter to display numbers with their three most significant digits and appropriate suffixes (K, M). It includes methods for filtering numbers, handling German number formats, and utilizing other modules for significant digit formatting.

classes.name: Coocook::Filter::NumberSuffix
classes.description: Perl package implementing a template filter to format numbers with suffixes.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Formats a number to have three significant digits and appends a suffix (K or M) if applicable.
